fixes.find:
The column 6, 6 is even, and this kernel's copies overlap evenly. Is the output
even? Explain the pattern, say what the same layer gives for the longer even
column 6, 6, 6, 6, and find a kernel of size 4 whose output for 6, 6 is even.
fixes.replace:
The column 6, 6 is the same value all the way along, and this kernel's copies
overlap evenly. Is the output the same value all the way along? If not, say
which values differ and why. Then say what the same layer gives for the longer
column 6, 6, 6, 6, and find a kernel of size 4 whose output for 6, 6 is the
same value all the way along.

indexPrompt.cv-kernel-four-stride-two: A transposed convolution with kernel size 4, stride 2 and padding 1 enlarges a map by a factor of 2. Apply it, with the kernel 1, 1, 1, 1, to the column 6, 6 and work out the output.
